name: Ahmad Al-Assad
title: Management and communication skills coach
bio_short: ILM-certified management and communication skills coach. Master's in Creativity and Giftedness. Specialises in leadership, public speaking, emotional intelligence and personality types.
bio: Ahmad is a specialist management and communication skills coach with a passion for helping people discover their talents and build their lives around them. He is an ILM-certified trainer with a BA in Marketing, a Master's degree in Creativity and Giftedness, and a post-graduate diploma in innovation and design thinking. Ahmad develops and delivers workshops on leadership, motivation, personality types, presentation and public speaking, communication skills, emotional intelligence and related topics. Besides corporate training, he is also an accomplished presenter and public speaker.
bio_long: Ahmad is a specialist management and communication skills coach with a passion for helping people discover their talents and build their lives around them. He is an ILM-certified trainer with a BA in Marketing, a Master's degree in Creativity and Giftedness, and a post-graduate diploma in innovation and design thinking. Ahmad develops and delivers workshops on leadership, motivation, personality types, presentation and public speaking, communication skills, emotional intelligence and related topics. Besides corporate training, he is also an accomplished presenter and public speaker. His training style is energetic and participatory, combining academic rigour with practical exercises that help participants apply concepts immediately in their professional roles. He draws on his background in creativity and giftedness to design workshops that go beyond conventional approaches to leadership and communication, helping participants identify and leverage their individual strengths. Ahmad has particular expertise in helping professionals understand and work with different personality types, using this understanding to improve team dynamics, communication effectiveness and leadership impact. His sessions on emotional intelligence equip participants with tools to manage their own responses and read others more effectively in high-stakes professional situations. He brings a genuine enthusiasm for personal development that energises participants and creates a learning environment where people feel comfortable stretching beyond their comfort zones.
